user.title: Lighting Phase - Setup
user.description: Set up one zone. You can add more Lighting Phase zones later, each with its own name, lux sensor (or elevation-only) and thresholds.

data.name: Zone name (e.g. "Backyard", "Front Porch")
data.notify_target: Notify service target (e.g. mobile_app_your_phone, blank to disable)

lux_thresholds.title: Lux Thresholds
lux_thresholds.description: Illuminance level (lux) at which each phase transitions to the next. These become number entities you can retune later without reconfiguring.

elevation_thresholds.title: Sun Elevation Thresholds
elevation_thresholds.description: Sun elevation (degrees) used in calculated mode, and as a cross-check against the lux sensor.

data.storm_lux_percent: Storm cutoff (% of recent rolling peak lux)

init.title: Lighting Phase - Options
init.description: Threshold values are adjustable directly on their own number entities. These settings require a reload to take effect.
